<!-- generated by a2a-docs, do not edit -->

The specification marks with `UNMAPPED` each rule of A2A it does not hold, in a YAML comment beside the place the rule belongs. `ess/` has 37 markers: 36 name a construct ESS lacks (an ESS gap), 1 an open question. Each row links the marker's line and shows its first sentence; the comment there carries the source quote and, for an ESS gap, the refusal ESS gave.

The HTTP+JSON routes ESS cannot serve at A2A's path are on [HTTP+JSON routes](./http-routes.md).

## `ess/components.yaml`

| Line | Kind | Marker |
|---|---|---|
| [10](https://github.com/beyond10x/a2a/blob/main/ess/components.yaml#L10) | ESS gap | the binding itself. ESS 0.67.0 binds a command to an HTTP route (ess-http/1), one method and path each, while JSON-RPC sends every method to one endpoint and dispatches on the body's `method`. |
| [33](https://github.com/beyond10x/a2a/blob/main/ess/components.yaml#L33) | ESS gap | no authored scenario holds -32601 or -32602. An act expects one refusal, `refused: not_granted`; there is none for an input the declaration rejects or for an unknown command, and a scenario naming an undeclared command is refused by name. |
| [59](https://github.com/beyond10x/a2a/blob/main/ess/components.yaml#L59) | ESS gap | push delivery. Section 4.3.3: "When a task update occurs, the agent sends an HTTP POST request to the configured webhook URL", and the same section: "Agents MUST attempt delivery at least once for each configured webhook". |
| [74](https://github.com/beyond10x/a2a/blob/main/ess/components.yaml#L74) | ESS gap | the stream transport. Section 11.7: "REST streaming uses Server-Sent Events", answering `Content-Type: text/event-stream` with one `data:` line per StreamResponse; JSON-RPC streams over SSE too (section 9.4.2), gRPC as a server stream (10.7). |

## `ess/http.yaml`

| Line | Kind | Marker |
|---|---|---|
| [8](https://github.com/beyond10x/a2a/blob/main/ess/http.yaml#L8) | ESS gap | the `/{tenant}/...` additional binding of every operation, for example `post: "/{tenant}/message:send"` beside `post: "/message:send"`. |
| [31](https://github.com/beyond10x/a2a/blob/main/ess/http.yaml#L31) | ESS gap | DELETE carries its inputs outside the path in a JSON body, where section 11.5 says "HTTP methods that do not support request bodies (GET, DELETE) MUST transmit operation request parameters as path parameters or query parameters": `query` encoding is admitted on `get` only (ESS-HTTP-020). |
| [56](https://github.com/beyond10x/a2a/blob/main/ess/http.yaml#L56) | ESS gap | a2a.proto CancelTask, post "/tasks/{id=\*}:cancel", body "\*", and SubscribeToTask, get "/tasks/{id=\*}:subscribe" (section 11.3.2 writes `POST /tasks/{id}:subscribe`), keep their derived routes, `post /tasks/commands/tasks:cancel` and `post /tasks/commands/tasks:subscribe`. |
